title: HelperFSRootParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's root op. The navigation root is the provider's warm start: a path the caller verified (an OSC 7 working directory) is re-checked at call time and falls back to the account's home directory, labelled inferred, when it is gone. The path is optional because a caller with nothing verified has nothing to state; a path that is present but unusable is not an error, it is the inferred case with its reason.

path.description: The caller's verified working directory, if it has one. Absolute and clean, as the provider's path syntax requires; a path this host cannot use yields the labelled home root rather than a refusal.
